author: xufang-lisa
title: Windows build fails to finalize developer package artifact upload with ENOTFOUND
signature: Failed to FinalizeArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND|Network

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Step 'Upload OpenVINO developer package' failed after a successful blob upload because the action could not resolve a GitHub Actions service hostname when finalizing the artifact (DNS resolution failure, ENOTFOUND).

root_cause: The 'Build / Build' job (self-hosted Windows runner, aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build) completed the full build and successfully streamed the 118MB developer_package.zip to Azure blob storage, but the subsequent FinalizeArtifact API call (actions/toolkit artifact client, used by the ababushk/upload-artifact action) failed with a DNS resolution error (ENOTFOUND) when contacting the GitHub Actions results service. This is a transient self-hosted-runner networking/DNS blip, not a problem with the PR's change (which only touches cmake/dependencies.cmake, a one-line comment addition). The job otherwise completed every build/install/test-packaging step successfully before this single network hiccup aborted the step.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a transient infrastructure/network failure during artifact finalization on a self-hosted runner; it is not reproducible by re-running the build locally. Re-running the failed job (or the whole run) on a healthy runner is expected to succeed, since the build itself completed without error.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Build / Build' job (the automated remediation path handles this).
If ENOTFOUND recurs frequently for this runner pool, check aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build DNS/outbound-network health and GitHub Actions service status.
Consider adding retry/backoff around FinalizeArtifact calls in the ababushk/upload-artifact fork if this keeps recurring.
prevention_strategies: No code change is needed for this specific failure since it is infra/network-related. To reduce blast radius of transient FinalizeArtifact failures, consider wrapping the upload-artifact step with a short retry (e.g., via a composite action) for 'Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND'/'ECONNREFUSED' style errors, and monitor the aks-win-16-cores-32gb-build runner pool for recurring DNS failures.
historical_context: Related prior FinalizeArtifact/CreateArtifact ENOTFOUND failures are recorded in patterns 6b6a229047392a0f (Build / Build specific, 1 occurrence, first seen 2026-07-01), 4e9cf236bf92d555 (CreateArtifact ENOTFOUND, Network, 2 occurrences), 272cc033ad86cee8 and 669fb8e126e09420 (CreateArtifact ENOTFOUND variants), and 0c33a04c2cbe783c (FinalizeArtifact ECONNREFUSED, Network, 2 occurrences). All were resolved by re-running the affected job; none required a code fix.
